text: Dr. Kelly White billed 29 claims after credential CRD_000260 was revoked on 2023-06-12, starting 770 days later. Still, no corroborating signal attaches, and volume alone does not clear the escalation ramp. Next step: this one is worth the registry call ahead of the others in its band.
